title: CLP Manifest
description: Schema for Character, Location, and Prop (CLP) consistency assets in OpenMontage. Adopts One Signature Look per Episode.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this CLP manifest belongs to

decision_log_ref.description: Reference ID in decision_log for style/aesthetic decisions

characters.description: List of character profiles. Each character has one signature composite appearance (Face + Costume).

id.description: Unique identifier for the character, e.g. char_amy

role.description: Role in the story (e.g., Protagonist, Antagonist, Host)

visual_traits.description: Detailed visual description of physical features, face, hair, and costume

voice_id.description: Voice identifier for TTS engines (ElevenLabs, Azure, etc.)

image.description: Relative path to composite appearance master image

asset_sha256.description: SHA-256 binary digest of the master image for CAS verification

gcs_url.description: Cloud storage URL for remote access and sharing

prompt_anchor.description: Concise natural language keywords to anchor character appearance in prompts

policy.description: Single source of truth for reference enforcement; strict_reference implies a strict lock

locations.description: List of environment and setting profiles for spatial consistency

id.description: Unique identifier for the location, e.g. loc_laboratory

environment_description.description: Detailed visual description of the setting, architecture, mood

lighting.description: Lighting conditions (e.g., Golden hour, moody overcast, neon glow)

palette.description: Color hex codes or key palette terms

image.description: Relative path to local reference image

asset_sha256.description: SHA-256 binary digest of the master image

gcs_url.description: Cloud storage URL for remote access

prompt_anchor.description: Concise natural language keywords to anchor environment in prompts

policy.description: Single source of truth for reference enforcement; strict_reference implies a strict lock

props.description: List of hero objects, key devices, diagram assets, or brand products

id.description: Unique identifier for the prop, e.g. prop_quantum_core

description.description: Physical description, shape, function, distinctive marks

material.description: Surface texture and material (e.g., brushed titanium, matte plastic)

asset_sha256.description: SHA-256 binary digest of the master image

gcs_url.description: Cloud storage URL for remote access

prompt_anchor.description: Concise natural language keywords to anchor prop in prompts

policy.description: Single source of truth for reference enforcement; strict_reference implies a strict lock
